item.title: He was picked as the worst American in the US history
item.description:
US President Donald Trump may be one of the most despised Americans in history, and now there is solid evidence that many in the United States see the Commander-in-Chief as the worst American in the country’s history. (©The Daily Digest)
On July 1st, YouGov published the findings from an interesting survey conducted ahead of America’s 250th birthday that found Trump topped the shortlist of possible candidates for the worst American in US history.
A shocking finding considering his competition. According to the data, 32% of the 1,110 US adult citizens polled between June 23rd and June 25th thought that Trump was the worst American in US history, which was a rather shocking finding considering the other options. - Ranked worse than ruthless serial killers When pitted against ruthless serial killers like Jeffrey Dahmer (8%) and Ted Bundy (4%), Trump blew them out of the water as the worst American in the history of the United States. He also performed poorly against other key figures.
Trump performed more poorly than a cult leader Trump scored 28 percentage points higher than cult leader Charles Manson, who racked up just 6% of the vote in the polling, and a whopping 31 points ahead of famed American traitor Benedict Arnold (3%). He even beat Jeffrey Epstein.
- The poll also ranked the greatest Americans, Abraham Lincoln took the top spot According to the data, 18% of poll respondents said Abraham Lincoln was the greatest American in US history. Lincoln was followed by another former US President, George Washington, at 13%, and Dr. Martin Luther King, at 12%. ©Provided by The Daily Digest
Other great Americans Another 4% of respondents chose Albert Einstein, putting one of the greatest minds that the world has ever seen in sixth place, followed by inventors Nikola Tesla (4%), Thomas Edison (3%), and entertainment superstar Michael Jackson (2%).
Looking at the country’s greatest moments The YouGov survey also asked about the best and worst moments in US history; the founding of the country was selected as the best moment in the nation’s history with 20% of the vote, followed by the abolition of slavery (18%).
Civil rights, Obama’s election, and World War II Another 10% thought the Civil Rights Act of 1964 was the third greatest moment in US history, 9% chose the election of Barack Obama in 2008, putting it in fourth place, and 9% thought the victory in World War II was worthy of ranking fifth.
Ranking the worst moments in US history ©The Daily Digest When it came to the worst moment in US history, 24% of the poll’s respondents thought slavery was the worst moment, followed by 16% who said the election of Donald Trump in 2016.

item.title: I looked at my past self on this site, god I hated what I saw.
item.description: I recently discovered while browsing my account that you can see your oldest comments. I did it so I could find a particular gif. However, I forgot what Imgur and what I was like 8 years ago. I was still brainwashed by the MAGA at the time, I was making horrific comments about people transitioning (well before I found out I was genderfluid), I didn't believe in Climate change, I was rude to people, and worst of all I feel for the (ugh, I hate this) the "Shadman no, Shadman yes" meme that made rounds on Imgur in the 2018-2019. Cut to today, I want to beat the snot out of my past self. I discovered I was tricked by my parents to blandly follow trump until 2020, I discovered last year I was genderfluid, and I have met so many great people after changing my world view and I have become great friends with all of them. I hate what I saw on this account and I could just delete the comments, but there was too much to bare. So, in order for me to find peace and bury this shitty version of myself for good, I'm going to be nuking my account and starting fresh. I want to put this shitty past behind me for ever. I'm not leaving Imgur for good, but I want to start a new beginning. Also if you find this post, know that people can change for the better. And you can always start again. Thank you EDIT: I'm seeing a lot of you telling me I shouldn't delete my account. I never really considered using my account as a way to prove that people can change. I'm still thinking about it, but I might consider keeping this account. It's just GOD DAMN IT! I want to punt my past self's fat pale ass out a 2nd story window.

item.title: We're prepping an evac plan
item.description:
Yey! Things are going well! ...... Wait.. What? Summerland is on fire? Well.... fuck....
We're prepping go bags, planned for a place to go. Animals will be first to evac if the alert area gets to us. Having to beg and borrow every penny to pay for things we need like gas in the car, taking pictures to update insurance, packing bags to be ready to go, trying not to have an anxiety attack. "Wheee" Edit: Just sent my partner to the ER in an ambulance. They think she's having an anxiety attack and an asthma attack at the same time. This smoke is no joke. If you have loved ones with breathing problems, check in on them and make sure they're okay. Stay safe out there everyone.
